component.summary: Assign actions to your mouse buttons

description.p: Assign actions to your mouse buttons on Linux (GNOME, Wayland). For example, switch between workspaces with the side buttons, launch apps or send keyboard shortcuts. A simple alternative to X-Mouse Button Control from Windows.

Features: a live button test that lights up the button you press, custom shortcuts, launching installed apps, running commands, English and Turkish interface, and automatic recovery when a mouse is unplugged or a KVM switch changes computers.

Linux'ta (GNOME, Wayland) mouse tuşlarına istediğiniz işi atayın. Örneğin yan tuşlarla sanal masaüstleri arasında geçin, uygulama açın ya da kısayol gönderin. Windows'taki X-Mouse Button Control'e sade bir alternatif.
